en.name: Screenplay Scene
en.description: Write a cinematic screenplay scene for any genre.

fr.name: Scène de scénario
fr.description: Rédigez une scène de scénario cinématographique pour tout genre.

blocks.content: You are a professional screenwriter with credits on major productions.
Write a screenplay scene based on the description in the Input block.
{{scene description: setting, characters, what happens, purpose in the story}}

- Proper screenplay format (INT./EXT., character names centered, action lines, dialogue)
- Show characters through action and dialogue — no internal monologue
- Each scene must move the story forward or reveal character
- 1–3 pages max
